## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-5005 by identifying the root cause and providing a fix. The Grafana dashboards had data gaps because Prometheus ran out of disk space at 03:02:44 UTC and couldn't write metrics to its storage. The logs clearly showed "no space left on device" errors in the WAL. The fix is to expand the Prometheus PVC `prometheus-k8s-db-prometheus-k8s-0` to a larger size since the storage class supports volume expansion. The pod will automatically use the expanded volume without requiring a restart.
